fact: The Foaming Mug Tavern is a staggeringly large cave converted into an inn specifically built to house visitors to Blingdenstone.
source_quote: Foaming Mug Tavern, a staggeringly large cave converted into an inn specifically built to house visitors to Blingdenstone
subject: Foaming Mug Tavern

fact: The tavern's rooms have beds large enough for dwarves, elves, dragonborn, and ogres, not just deep gnomes.
source_quote: Its rooms had beds large enough for dwarves, elves, dragonborn, ogres, and other “normal-sized” guests
subject: Foaming Mug Tavern rooms

fact: The Foaming Mug Tavern serves Darklake Stout imported through Mantol-Derith.
source_quote: The tavern served Darklake Stout imported through Mantol-Derith
subject: Darklake Stout

fact: Tappy Foamstrap is the proprietor of the Foaming Mug Tavern and is a bored deep gnome.
source_quote: Its proprietor, Tappy Foamstrap, was a bored deep gnome
subject: Tappy Foamstrap

fact: Tappy Foamstrap is desperate for new stories after hearing every local’s troubles dozens of times.
source_quote: desperate for new stories after hearing every local’s troubles dozens of times
subject: Tappy Foamstrap

fact: The ghost problem in Blingdenstone is worsening with spirits haunting the catacombs.
source_quote: The ghost problem was worsening, with spirits now haunting Blingdenstone’s catacombs
subject: Blingdenstone ghost problem

fact: Scouts saw a crazy gnome from the first days of the reclamation skulking through unrecovered portions of Blingdenstone.
source_quote: Scouts had reportedly seen a crazy gnome from the first days of the reclamation skulking through unrecovered portions of the settlement
subject: Crazy Gnome Scout sighting

fact: The party suspects the crazy gnome sighted in Blingdenstone is the Pudding King.
source_quote: whom the party suspected was the Pudding King
subject: Pudding King

fact: The Stoneheart Enclave is reportedly closing in on a solution to Ogrémoch’s Bane.
source_quote: The Stoneheart Enclave was said to be “closing in on a solution” to Ogrémoch’s Bane
subject: Stoneheart Enclave

fact: The party believes the Stoneheart Enclave's solution to Ogrémoch’s Bane is to send the party to deal with it.
source_quote: since the solution was evidently to send them to deal with it
subject: Stoneheart Enclave solution

fact: Debate continues in Blingdenstone over whether the wererats should be considered gnomes.
source_quote: Debate also continued over the wererats and whether they should be considered gnomes at all
subject: Wererat debate

fact: A merchant recently returned from Gracklstugh described the duergar city as outwardly calm but deeply on edge.
source_quote: A merchant recently returned from Gracklstugh described the duergar city as outwardly calm but deeply on edge
subject: Merchant from Gracklstugh

fact: Gracklstugh's authorities imposed controls and blamed the Ember Vanguard for recent chaos.
source_quote: The authorities had imposed controls while blaming the Ember Vanguard for recent chaos
subject: Gracklstugh Authorities

fact: The Ember Vanguard is being blamed by Gracklstugh authorities for recent chaos.
source_quote: blaming the Ember Vanguard for recent chaos
subject: Ember Vanguard

fact: The merchant from Gracklstugh carried a wanted poster that misspells "alive" as "a-live" or similar.
source_quote: the merchant carried a wanted poster reading “wanted dead or alive,” with “alive” misspelled
subject: Wanted poster

fact: The wanted poster depicts a red dragonborn rather than a gold one.
source_quote: the poster depicted a red rather than gold dragonborn
subject: Wanted poster

fact: The wanted poster depicts the drow, orc, and dwarf as older and more fearsome than the party members.
source_quote: as well as an older and more fearsome drow, orc, and dwarf
subject: Wanted poster

fact: The merchant from Gracklstugh mentioned rumors that the Assassin’s Guild had returned.
source_quote: He also mentioned rumors that the Assassin’s Guild had returned
subject: Assassin's Guild

fact: There is an influx of unexplained surface coins in Gracklstugh.
source_quote: an influx of unexplained surface coins
subject: Surface coins in Gracklstugh

fact: Summary executions, decapitations, and derro heads displayed on pikes occurred in Gracklstugh.
source_quote: summary executions, decapitations, and derro heads displayed on pikes
subject: Gracklstugh executions

fact: The duergar in Gracklstugh have been emphatic about the derro needing to "learn their place."
source_quote: the duergar had been emphatic about the derro needing to “learn their place.”
subject: Gracklstugh Duergar

fact: There is a peculiarly portly red dragon in Gracklstugh used as an extravagant matchlighter.
source_quote: Gracklstugh’s peculiarly portly red dragon, used as an extravagant matchlighter
subject: Gracklstugh Dragon

fact: The red dragon in Gracklstugh has a double chin and two bellies.
source_quote: distinguished by a double chin and two bellies
subject: Gracklstugh Dragon

fact: Gracklstugh has not collapsed into open war despite its internal conflicts.
source_quote: Despite the city’s murders, assassinations, political struggles, and controlled chaos, it had not collapsed into open war
subject: Gracklstugh stability

fact: The party is relieved that Gracklstugh did not burn down during their stay.
source_quote: The party was relieved that its goal of leaving Gracklstugh without causing the city to burn down had been achieved
subject: Party relief

fact: A deep gnome returning from the Whiteshell Mine reported encountering dancing myconids.
source_quote: A deep gnome returning from the Whiteshell Mine offered another strange report: he had encountered a parade of dancing myconids
subject: Deep Gnome Miner

fact: Myconids were seen communicating through Rapport Spores and announcing they were going to a wedding celebration.
source_quote: communicating through Rapport Spores and announcing that they were on their way to a wedding celebration
subject: Myconids

fact: The party suspects Neverlight Grove might be emptying or its inhabitants have gone insane due to the myconid behavior.
source_quote: The dancing myconids might mean Neverlight Grove was emptying—or that its inhabitants had gone completely insane
subject: Neverlight Grove

fact: Glabbagool cleaned the tavern floor by absorbing spilled drinks and became intoxicated.
source_quote: Glabbagool cleaned the tavern floor by absorbing spilled drinks and became increasingly intoxicated
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool began singing traditional gelatinous cube sea shanties while intoxicated.
source_quote: The gelatinous cube grew loopier than usual and began singing traditional gelatinous cube sea shanties
subject: Glabbagool

fact: The party is considering using alcohol against hostile oozes and puddings.
source_quote: inspired the party to consider using alcohol against hostile oozes and puddings
subject: Alcohol against oozes

fact: Tappy Foamstrap agreed to provide barrels of old or spoiled booze if no one attributed its quality to the tavern.
source_quote: He was willing to provide it only if no one attributed its questionable quality to the Foaming Mug
subject: Tappy's deal

fact: The party suggested Tappy could advertise himself as the hero whose alcohol saved the city.
source_quote: The party countered that he might instead advertise himself as the hero whose alcohol saved the city
subject: Tappy's counter-offer

fact: Tappy agreed to provide the alcohol if Blingdenstone’s leaders provide an official notice for him to display.
source_quote: Tappy agreed if Blingdenstone’s leaders would provide an official notice he could display behind the bar
subject: Tappy's condition

fact: The party discussed using a seltzer bottle as a delivery mechanism for the alcohol.
source_quote: The party also discussed using Shape Water, a seltzer bottle, mugs, or some other improvised delivery mechanism to spray the alcohol
subject: Seltzer bottle

fact: A deep gnome returned from the Whiteshell Mine.
source_quote: A deep gnome returning from the Whiteshell Mine offered another strange report
subject: Whiteshell Mine

fact: Darklake Stout is imported through Mantol-Derith.
source_quote: The tavern served Darklake Stout imported through Mantol-Derith
subject: Mantol-Derith
